owner: Public Code Security / PSR-15 recurring assurance
premise: For an honest browser/runtime executing the exact admitted FAE release artifact, the transaction intent presented to the user must be the transaction payload actually authorized for signing; delivery/provenance controls must make artifact substitution detectable.
bounded_claims: This gate may prove exact-release binding and intent-to-signing-payload integrity under tested browser mutations.
This gate may prove fail-closed behavior for controlled DOM/script/payload substitution cases.
non_claims: No protection is claimed once arbitrary malicious same-origin JavaScript already executes with wallet authority.
No protection is claimed against a fully compromised browser profile, device, OS, or user-approved malicious software.
A non-extractable wrapping key does not by itself provide same-origin script isolation.
required_evidence: All wallet/signing browser source used by the candidate is present in Git history and bound to an immutable revision.
Release provenance binds the deployed browser artifact to that immutable revision.
Browser regression: displayed destination/amount/fee/network equals the canonical payload supplied to the signing function.
Controlled mutation: destination, amount, fee, network, transaction body, or signing-call substitution after user review fails closed or is detected before signature release.
No seed phrase, passphrase, private key, or decrypted vault bytes enter evidence.

current_blocker.evidence: sovereign-forge/browser/README.md states live index.html/core.js/wallet-crypto.js/wallet.js/bip39-en.js are not yet fully in Git history.
current_blocker.disposition: Do not claim delivered-code/signing integrity closed until exact browser source and release artifact are bindable.
